items.title: Python Complete Course - Beginner To Advanced (Updated 2025)
items.reviewText: This course was very detailed however at times I would become lost as the trainer wasn't always clear and got muddled himself. It would have  been helpful if we got the code modules in downloadable format to go through the syntaxes in slow time, as the screen view from trainer was too small when coding which made it difficult to see and follow. It didn't make much of a difference if you used full screen.

items.title: Python Complete Course - Beginner To Advanced (Updated 2025)
items.reviewText: Outdated reviews.  Course from 2020.  Unable to understand a lot of what is being said by the video 'tutor', due to his accent and stuttering, stop start talking.  Too much unnecessary software to download.  Gave up and tried a course somewhere else.
